subject: Integration kickoff: Acme platform onboarding & SDK warmstart
messages:
From: Stephanie Nguyen <stephanie@redwood.ai>
To: Samira Khan <samira@acme.com>
Cc: Vivek Kulkarni <vivek@redwood.ai>, Monica Patel <monica@redwood.ai>
Date: 2026-11-14T09:12:00-07:00
Subject: Integration kickoff: Acme platform onboarding & SDK warmstart

Hi Samira —

Great to meet you yesterday. This thread is to align on the technical handoff and immediate implementation work so your engineers can begin a safe warmstart into our SDKs and API endpoints. Quick summary of the asks we agreed on during the call: 

- Provide sandbox service account credentials (API key or scoped token) and any IP allowlist rows.
- Share a short sample payload for your typical inference calls (avg token length, concurrency profile).
- Confirm the earliest cutover window for endpoint migration testing (we suggested Wed 11/18 - Thu 11/19).

What we will deliver this week:
- A lightweight SDK quickstart bundle (attached) with a Node + Python sample that demonstrates: connection, request retries, timeout settings, and backoff behavior.
- An integration checklist (attached) with preflight tests: auth, network, KV-cache priming, and prefix cache validation.
- A short runbook for rate-limit handling and suggested thresholds based on your expected RPS.

Two tactical asks for your engineers to unblock us:
1) Sandbox API key with the following scopes: inference.read, inference.write, telemetry.post.
2) A one-paragraph JSON sample of a representative request (prompt length, system messages if used).

Attached: acme_onboard_checklist.xlsx (preflight + cutover steps), sdk-example-snippets.zip (sample code and curl).

If you want, Vivek can run a 30-minute walkthrough of the SDK snippets on Wednesday — Monica and I will coordinate.

Thanks,
Stephanie
Director, Customer Success — Redwood Inference

---
Note: attachment stubs: acme_onboard_checklist.xlsx (spreadsheet, 14KB), sdk-example-snippets.zip (archive, 320KB)

From: Samira Khan <samira@acme.com>
To: Stephanie Nguyen <stephanie@redwood.ai>
Cc: Acme Platform Team <platform-team@acme.com>
Date: 2026-11-14T12:46:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Integration kickoff: Acme platform onboarding & SDK warmstart

Thanks Stephanie — this is perfect. 

Quick answers:
- We'll provision a sandbox API key and email it to you via our secrets portal by end of day Monday (IT policy). Expect the token to be scoped as requested.
- Representative payload: attached below (also pasted). Average prompt ~ 220 tokens, typical max ~ 1,200. Bursty concurrency during peak billing runs (~200 RPS sustained for 3–5 minutes).

Quoted sample payload (we use system + user messages):
{
  "model": "redwood-large-v1",
  "messages": [
    {"role": "system", "content": "You are an assistant for Acme billing support."},
    {"role": "user", "content": "Summarize charges for invoice INV-2026-11 and highlight anomalies."}
  ],
  "max_tokens": 600
}

We are open to Vivek's walkthrough. Wednesday 11/18 10:00–10:30 PT works for our team. Please send a calendar invite.

One note on network: we currently have a CIDR range we can add to allowlist but need to know the egress IPs you expect for Redwood sandbox. If you can provide a small list, we can pre-configure.

Samira
Senior Platform Engineer, Acme Inc

---
Quoted-for-context: Samira attached sample_request.json (36B)

From: Stephanie Nguyen <stephanie@redwood.ai>
To: Samira Khan <samira@acme.com>
Cc: Vivek Kulkarni <vivek@redwood.ai>, Monica Patel <monica@redwood.ai>, Ben Carter <ben@redwood.ai>
Date: 2026-11-16T14:03:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Integration kickoff: Acme platform onboarding & SDK warmstart

Samira — thanks for the confirmation and the sample payload.

Per Vivek's notes, we'll:
- Send a calendar invite for Wed 11/18 10:00 PT with a 30-min walkthrough (Vivek leads; Monica covers quota & telemetry).
- Provision the sandbox quota bump and send the scoped API key via your secrets portal before EOD Monday (IT permitting).
- Share expected sandbox egress IPs by Monday so you can add them to the allowlist.

Immediate next steps for Acme (action items):
- Upload the sample payload to your secrets portal or paste it into the calendar invite so we can reference it.
- Add Redwood sandbox egress IPs once we send them (we'll keep the list minimal).
- Have an engineer available on Wed 11/18 to run the quick smoke tests during the walkthrough.

If anything blocks you before Monday, ping me or Monica and we'll triage. See attachments and the drive link for the snippets we mentioned.

Thanks and talk soon,
Stephanie
Director, Customer Success — Redwood Inference
